# Embed every file from esp32s31/www_gz/*.gz (produced by tools/build_www.py) and generate the asset table at configure time.
set(GEN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fp_assets_gen.c")
set(WWW_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../www_gz")
set(GZ_FILES "")

# IDF first evaluates component CMake files in a restricted "early expansion" mode (no file(GLOB CONFIGURE_DEPENDS), no generated files)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    file(GLOB GZ_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${WWW_DIR}/*.gz")

    set(DECLS "")
    set(TABLE "")
    set(COUNT 0)
    foreach(f ${GZ_FILES})
        get_filename_component(fname "${f}" NAME)                    # proc-core.js.gz
        string(REGEX REPLACE "\\.gz$" "" name "${fname}")             # proc-core.js
        string(REGEX REPLACE "[^a-zA-Z0-9]" "_" sym "${fname}")       # proc_core_js_gz
        if(name MATCHES "\\.html$")
            set(mime "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.js$")
            set(mime "application/javascript; charset=utf-8")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.css$")
            set(mime "text/css; charset=utf-8")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.json$")
            set(mime "application/json")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.svg$")
            set(mime "image/svg+xml")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.png$")
            set(mime "image/png")
        elseif(name MATCHES "\\.ico$")
            set(mime "image/x-icon")
        else()
            set(mime "application/octet-stream")
        endif()
        string(APPEND DECLS "extern const uint8_t _binary_${sym}_start[] asm(\"_binary_${sym}_start\");\n")
        string(APPEND DECLS "extern const uint8_t _binary_${sym}_end[] asm(\"_binary_${sym}_end\");\n")
        string(APPEND TABLE "    { \"/${name}\", \"${mime}\", _binary_${sym}_start, _binary_${sym}_end },\n")
        math(EXPR COUNT "${COUNT}+1")
    endforeach()

    file(WRITE "${GEN}.tmp"
"/* generated by components/web_ui/CMakeLists.txt - do not edit */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include \"fp_assets.h\"
${DECLS}
const fp_asset_t fp_assets[] = {
${TABLE}    { NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL }
};
const size_t fp_assets_count = ${COUNT};
")
    file(COPY_FILE "${GEN}.tmp" "${GEN}" ONLY_IF_DIFFERENT)
endif()

idf_component_register(SRCS "web_ui.c" "log_ring.c" "${GEN}"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       REQUIRES esp_http_server espressif__cjson fp_config fp_capture fp_dark fp_eth fp_image fp_session fp_wifi xray_relay
                       PRIV_REQUIRES log esp_timer heap esp_partition lwip)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    foreach(f ${GZ_FILES})
        target_add_binary_data(${COMPONENT_LIB} "${f}" BINARY)
    endforeach()
endif()
